title: Cyber Drift: Sunny Coast Cruiser
description: Drift along the sunny coastal highway. Dodge traffic barriers and draft behind high-speed hovercrafts.
synopsis: Fast-paced pseudo-3D highway drift racing with sunshine scenery and electronic synth beats.
instructions: Maintain high velocity without scraping roadside barriers. Collect sunshine energy tokens for nitro boosts.

title: Neon Survivor: Starry Sky Skiff
description: Pilot your sky skiff through floating cloud waves. Blast geometric rogue drones and harvest radiant energy cores.
synopsis: Top-down celestial sky shooter with 360-degree aiming and upgrading ordnance.
instructions: Defeat encroaching enemy waves and collect fallen energy cores to upgrade beam spread and shields.
highScoreGoal: Clear wave 15 to earn the Sky Admiral badge!

title: BUCC Promotion Hub
description: Classic Shooting action game, based on the idea of the promotion of BUCC
synopsis: Classic Shooting action game, based on the idea of the promotion of BUCC
instructions: Use controls to play and conquer the high score.
highScoreGoal: Aim for the GlitchNest leaderboard top spot!
